events.note: October 1035: Sancho III dies (18 October 1035) and 'Before his death in 1035, Sancho divided his possessions among his sons'; the western conquests (Zamora, León, Salamanca) go back to Vermudo III's León, as the Pamplona ledger's 1035 loss says. That loss moved nothing because the same year's split (Pamplona ledger 17) had already released the cells to nobody, which with the 1033-1034 ruling would leave them empty until León's keyframe of 1038.
